title: Almonds and Bell Peppers
ldInstructionsRaw: Trim the peppers eliminating the stalks, filaments and seeds; cut them into strips. Soak the raisins in warm water. Slice the almonds. Blanch the tomatoes for 30 seconds, then peel, remove the seeds and chop coarsely.|Heat the oil in a large shallow saucepan, add the peppers and let them soften for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally; then add 2 tablespoons of vinegar, a tablespoon of sugar, a pinch of salt, the soaked and drained raisins, the almonds and the tomatoes.|Cover, lower the heat and cook for another 8-10 minutes. Eat hot or enjoy them at room temperature.
